participant_1.name: Ethan
participant_1.personality: Creative and introspective, enjoys music and spending time with family. Has a strong sense of responsibility.
participant_1.background: I'm a recording engineer and own my own studio. My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. What's up? I am a 46-year-old single dad with kids. I live in California, but the recording artist market was dead last year. I prefer being inside.

participant_2.name: Sophia
participant_2.personality: Outgoing and compassionate, loves music and helping others. Enjoys sharing experiences and discovering new places.
participant_2.background: I volunteer at the homeless shelter. My father played violin professionally. I am a piano teacher on the side and play several instruments. I enjoy exploring new parts of the city.
